what: a cross-check of of3t-adaln's two independent determinations of the same quantity, both published in state/of3t-adaln.md. Nothing new was run.

the_contradiction.A_inferred: the MECHANISM section interpolates the synthetic K-ladder AT block 8's model rel of 18.504 and reads off K ~ 1.3e+06.
the_contradiction.B_measured: AMENDMENT5 measures K DIRECTLY on the reference's own float64 arithmetic as sum_i||term_i|| / ||sum_i term_i|| over the gain sum's per-token summands, with a self-check that the summands add back to the reference's gamma gradient at 3e-15 or better. Block 8 reads K = 172.60.
the_contradiction.gap: a factor of 7,532. Both are in the same document and only one can be right; the measured one is the measurement.

every_block_against_the_ladder_at_its_ow.columns: block, measured K, the ladder's device rel at that K, the model's rel, ratio
every_block_against_the_ladder_at_its_ow.reading: every block is 19x to 2,872x above the ladder's own device curve at its own measured cancellation ratio. THE LADDER EXPLAINS THE LADDER. It does not explain the model.

what_this_kills.the_framing: 'the campaign's worst gradient component is an ill-conditioned reduction, and this may simply not be computable' is DEAD. At the measured K of 17 to 208 the ladder's own HOST FP32 column reads ~1e-06 to ~3e-06. Single precision has no difficulty with these sums. Conditioning at the real K is not a constraint on anybody, and nothing here is unfixable in principle.
what_this_kills.the_interpolated_K: K ~ 1.3e+06 was never a measurement. It was read off a curve at the value being explained, which is circular, and the direct measurement contradicts it by three and a half orders of magnitude.
what_this_kills.D56_as_written: its mechanism section is withdrawn. Its DATA -- the ladder itself, the host-fp32 column, the constant ~2,172x device-to-fp32 ratio -- all stand as measurements of the synthetic construction.

what_survives_untouched: the softmax finding, because it is a direct A/B and not an inference from a curve: a float64 softmax takes block 8's leaf from 8.060854e-01 to 1.459256e-02 (55x), the sister AdaLN with no softmax above it moves 1.23x, and the whole block comes inside the 2.0e-02 bar at 1.489217e-02. The softmax is the locus. What is now unexplained is HOW it produces the magnitudes observed.

gap_1_synthetic_to_real_operands.to: block arm 8.060854e-01 at block 8 with real operands and the same K
gap_1_synthetic_to_real_operands.note: same cancellation ratio, same code, synthetic operands versus the model's own. The ladder holds a and s constant across tokens and alternates the cotangent's sign to construct K; the real block does not.

gap_2_block_arm_to_model.note: the row attributes this to the real cotangent, which is consistent with blocks 8 and 9 sitting 1.7 % apart in K and 150x apart in the model.

the_two_gaps_that_replace_the_one_explan.product: 125 x 23 = 2,872x, which is the whole discrepancy. Neither factor is conditioning.

the_caveat_that_must_be_checked_first: the measured K is over the 384 PER-TOKEN summands of one sample's gain sum. The model's gain gradient sums over 384 tokens x 48 samples = 18,432 terms. If cancellation across the sample axis is severe, the model's effective K could exceed the per-sample one. That cannot plausibly supply 2,872x -- 48 terms cannot add three and a half orders of magnitude of cancellation unless they nearly annihilate, and the accumulation probe shows the opposite (26.68x growth over 48, i.e. strongly CORRELATED, not cancelling) -- but it is the one measurement that would close the question and it has not been made.
